correctness.rationale: The graph is explicitly C5 Mycielskian with 11 vertices and 20 edges; radius-one closed-ball intersections at scale 2 are exactly the vertex closed-neighborhood simplices. Inspected original certificate verifier and independently reconstructed 213 faces with f-vector 11,55,90,45,11,1. Independently greedily performed 46 certified elementary free-pair removals (a different valid spine from package 55-step collapse), leaving 11 vertices,55 edges,55 triangles. After contraction of the star spanning tree, exact integral Smith normal form of the 45-rank 55x55 boundary has 44 unit diagonal factors and one 2, so H1=Z/2, H2 free rank 10, higher zero. Original certificate checks alternate 55-step collapse to 11,46,46 and 36x36 det +2 minor and mod2 rank35. No homotopy wedge inference from torsion.
